current.title: The Global Youth Statement 2026
current.intro: The Global Youth Statement brings together policy priorities developed by children and young people through YOUNGO consultations, working groups, LCOYs, RCOYs, and the Global Conference of Youth.
current.note: The 2026 statement is being developed for COY21 ahead of COP31 in Antalya. The call for individual and organisation inputs closes 31 July 2026, 23:59 UTC — submit through the official Global Youth Statement 2026 form.

priorities.title: Science-aligned NDCs
priorities.body: Nationally Determined Contributions that match the 1.5°C pathway and centre justice for young people and frontline communities.

priorities.title: Just energy transition
priorities.body: A full, fair, and fast phase-out of fossil fuels with renewables scale-up and energy access for all.

priorities.title: Meaningful youth inclusion
priorities.body: Intergenerational equity and the meaningful inclusion of children and youth in climate policymaking at every level.

priorities.title: Climate finance
priorities.body: Reforming climate finance so it is rooted in justice and accessible to the most vulnerable communities.

priorities.title: Adaptation & loss and damage
priorities.body: Prioritising adaptation and loss-and-damage responses as moral and political imperatives.

process.body: Gathering submissions from individuals, working groups, LCOYs, NGOs, and movements worldwide (2026 inputs deadline: 31 July).
LCOY and RCOY outputs, plus WG policy work, feed into regional and thematic drafts.
Inputs consolidated for clarity, balance, and alignment ahead of COY21.
The final statement is presented around COY21 / COP31 and used in YOUNGO advocacy with Parties and the UNFCCC.
